propositions: The `rebar metrics` subcommand must parse `--since` and `--until` date flags and `--output json|text` format flags to render the full metric registry over a specified date range

The command entry point must wire through an explicit `if sub == "metrics":` dispatch arm in `_cli.__init__._dispatch()` that imports and calls `rebar._commands.metrics`, placed on the reads path after store initialization

Registry hydration requires importing the full `rebar.metrics` package (not just `registry` module alone) so that reader modules' registration side-effects populate `REGISTRY` before the command evaluates specs

The render loop must evaluate every `MetricSpec` in the registry via `registry.evaluate(spec, context)`, wrapping each call in try-except to isolate faults and render unavailable metrics rather than crash on error

JSON output must be `{"since": <str>, "until": <str>, "metrics": {<id>: {lens, source, confidence, value} | {unavailable: {reason, accruing_since}}, ...}}` and text output must be one deterministic line per metric listing id, lens, source, and value-or-unavailable
The command implementation must not import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` module; this isolation is verified by a source-level scan assertion in tests
